verdict.rationale: Passkey support is a fair question for a password manager like 2FAS Pass, but nothing in the evidence mentions passkeys at all. The sync evidence covers TOTP tokens and Pass vault items via iCloud or Google Drive, not passkey storage or cross-ecosystem passkey sync, so it cannot be credited to this story.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
